Control Description: Confirm project objectives, scope, assumptions and exclusions
Dependency: Contract or SOW executed
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Establishes the authorized project scope, objectives, assumptions, exclusions and expected outcomes before technical discovery begins.

Control Description: Identify executive, technical, security and business stakeholders
Dependency: Approved project charter
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Identify decision makers, technical owners, business representatives, security contacts and escalation points.

Control Description: Schedule technical discovery workshops by capability area
Dependency: Stakeholder register
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Workshops should cover identity, security, endpoints, applications, infrastructure, data, collaboration and governance.

Control Description: Document required administrative roles and read-only access
Dependency: Stakeholder register and workshop schedule
License Requirement: Tenant-dependent administrative access
Leadership Notes: Use least-privileged and read-only access wherever possible during discovery.

Control Description: Collect current diagrams, policies, standards and procedures
Dependency: Access requirements communicated
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Collect network diagrams, tenant documentation, security standards, asset lists, application inventories and current operating procedures.

Control Description: Export managed and unmanaged endpoint inventory
Dependency: Required administrative access
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, RMM or equivalent inventory access when applicable
Leadership Notes: Include Windows, macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Android, servers, virtual desktops and unmanaged devices where discoverable.

Control Description: Identify operating systems, versions, editions and support status
Dependency: Device inventory
Applies When: Customers with managed or discoverable devices
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, RMM or equivalent inventory access when applicable
Leadership Notes: Identify unsupported, end-of-life and nonstandard operating systems that may affect security or modernization planning.

Control Description: Identify installed, managed and business-critical applications
Dependency: Device inventory and application-management access
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, Defender, RMM or software-inventory platform when applicable
Leadership Notes: Document business-critical applications, owners, installation methods, authentication dependencies and support status.

Control Description: Identify physical, virtual and cloud-hosted servers
Dependency: Infrastructure and platform access
License Requirement: Azure, virtualization platform or RMM access when applicable
Leadership Notes: Include physical servers, virtual machines, cloud workloads, domain controllers, application servers, file servers and database servers.

Control Description: Identify sanctioned and unsanctioned cloud applications
Dependency: Tenant access, stakeholder input and available discovery telemetry
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps or equivalent required for automated discovery
Leadership Notes: Differentiate approved, tolerated, unknown and prohibited cloud services and identify data or authentication dependencies.

Control Description: Export member, guest, service and administrative accounts
Dependency: Microsoft Entra administrative or read-only access
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID
Leadership Notes: Include active, disabled, inactive, guest, service, shared and privileged identities plus ownership and source-of-authority details.

Control Description: Inventory permanent and eligible privileged-role assignments
Dependency: Identity inventory and role-management access
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; Entra ID P2 required to assess eligible PIM assignments
Leadership Notes: Document permanent assignments, eligible assignments, administrative units, emergency-access accounts and excessive privilege.

Control Description: Map assigned licenses to required security capabilities
Dependency: Identity inventory and subscription access
License Requirement: None for manual assessment; feature availability depends on assigned Microsoft licenses
Leadership Notes: Map Business Premium, E3, E5, F3 and add-on licenses to required identity, endpoint, security, compliance and AI capabilities.

Control Description: Capture current security scores, recommendations and exposures
Dependency: Tenant security portal access
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender and Secure Score capabilities vary by license
Leadership Notes: Capture current configuration posture, exposed identities, vulnerable devices, unresolved recommendations and major security gaps.

Control Description: Inventory authentication, Conditional Access and security policies
Dependency: Tenant administrative or read-only access
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 required for Conditional Access; advanced risk capabilities require Entra ID P2
Leadership Notes: Inventory authentication methods, Conditional Access, identity protection, endpoint, email, collaboration and security policies.

Control Description: Inventory SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, file shares and data repositories
Dependency: Tenant access, storage access and repository-owner input
License Requirement: Microsoft 365 and source-platform access; advanced data discovery may require Microsoft Purview licensing
Leadership Notes: Include Microsoft 365 locations, file servers, cloud-storage platforms, structured data stores and other repositories relevant to Copilot or agent grounding.

Control Description: Identify anonymous links, external sharing and guest-access exposure
Dependency: Data repository inventory and sharing-report access
Applies When: Customers using SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams or external collaboration
License Requirement: Microsoft 365; advanced analysis may require Microsoft Purview or SharePoint Advanced Management
Leadership Notes: Identify anonymous links, organization-wide links, stale guests, externally shared sites and unmanaged collaboration paths.

Control Description: Identify broad permissions, excessive access and oversharing
Dependency: Data repository inventory and permissions-report access
License Requirement: Microsoft 365; advanced oversharing analysis may require Microsoft Purview or SharePoint Advanced Management
Leadership Notes: Identify direct permissions, broad groups, organization-wide access, broken inheritance, stale access and repositories lacking accountable owners.

Control Description: Inventory sensitivity labels, retention and DLP policies
Dependency: Tenant compliance access and repository inventory
Applies When: Customers with Microsoft 365 data or compliance requirements
License Requirement: Microsoft Purview capabilities and licensing vary by feature
Complexity Driver: Compliance scope and existing policy maturity
Leadership Notes: Document existing sensitivity labels, retention policies, DLP policies, records controls, policy modes, exceptions and coverage gaps.

Control Description: Identify data sources available to Copilot and agents
Dependency: Repository, sharing, permission and data-protection assessments
Applies When: Customers pursuing Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio or organizational agents
License Requirement: Microsoft 365 Copilot or Copilot Studio licenses only when validating licensed experiences
Leadership Notes: Assess authoritative sources, duplicate content, stale information, oversharing, ownership, searchability and suitability for AI grounding.

Control Description: Define target-state identity, endpoint, security, data and AI architecture
Dependency: Discovery assessments substantially complete
License Requirement: None for architecture development; target capabilities depend on selected Microsoft licenses
Leadership Notes: Define the desired end state across identity, devices, applications, infrastructure, security, collaboration, data governance and AI.

Control Description: Compare current-state capabilities to the target state
Dependency: Current-state assessments and target-state architecture
License Requirement: None
Complexity Driver: Number and severity of identified gaps
Leadership Notes: Document missing capabilities, configuration weaknesses, unsupported technology, process gaps, ownership gaps and licensing constraints.

Control Description: Classify findings by risk, business impact and remediation urgency
Dependency: Gap analysis
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Prioritize findings using likelihood, impact, exposure, operational dependency, regulatory relevance and remediation urgency.

Control Description: Sequence remediation activities by phase, dependency and priority
Dependency: Prioritized risk register and target-state architecture
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Sequence work to stabilize identity and security before major migrations, governance deployment and AI expansion.

Control Description: Assign estimated effort and duration to implementation activities
Dependency: Implementation roadmap and defined scope assumptions
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Document estimated engineering effort, elapsed duration, assumptions, customer responsibilities and potential complexity multipliers.

Control Description: Define decision-making, escalation and approval processes
Dependency: Stakeholder register and approved project charter
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Define decision rights, technical approval authority, executive escalation, risk acceptance and change authorization.

Control Description: Define project status, risk and milestone reporting cadence
Dependency: Governance plan
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Establish a consistent cadence for progress, milestones, decisions, risks, issues, dependencies, budget and resource reporting.

Control Description: Establish scope and technical change-control procedures
Dependency: Governance plan and approved scope
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Define change intake, impact assessment, approval, scheduling, rollback and documentation requirements.

Control Description: Define stakeholder and end-user communication requirements
Dependency: Stakeholder register, roadmap and change-control process
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Define communications for executives, technical teams, department leaders, end users, support teams and external partners.

Control Description: Identify adoption, training and organizational readiness requirements
Dependency: Implementation roadmap and communication plan
License Requirement: None
Leadership Notes: Identify training audiences, support readiness, champions, adoption risks, resistance points and success measurements before implementation begins.

Control Description: Define account provisioning, modification and deprovisioning standards
Dependency: Phase 0 identity inventory and stakeholder approval
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID
Leadership Notes: Define authoritative identity sources, approval paths, ownership, SLAs and joiner-mover-leaver requirements.

Control Description: Configure identification and remediation of inactive accounts
Dependency: Identity inventory and account-lifecycle standard
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; automation capabilities may require Entra ID P1 or P2
Leadership Notes: Define inactivity thresholds, notification, disabling, license removal, deletion and documented exception handling.

Control Description: Configure guest expiration and recurring access reviews
Dependency: Guest inventory and business-owner identification
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance for automated access reviews
Leadership Notes: Implement sponsor ownership, expiration, access reviews, inactivity handling and removal procedures.

Control Description: Inventory service accounts and document ownership and purpose
Dependency: Identity and application inventories
Applies When: Customers with service or application accounts
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; workload identities may require additional Entra licensing
Leadership Notes: Record each account's owner, purpose, authentication method, privilege, application dependency and rotation requirements.

Control Description: Configure banned-password and password-protection settings
Dependency: Identity assessment and hybrid identity discovery
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; on-premises password protection requires agents and appropriate licensing
Leadership Notes: Configure custom banned passwords, smart lockout and on-premises password-protection integration where applicable.

Control Description: Configure the tenant authentication-methods policy
Dependency: Identity assessment and licensing alignment
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; advanced authentication features vary by license
Complexity Driver: Current authentication methods and legacy dependencies
Leadership Notes: Define approved methods and restrict weak or unsupported methods using the centralized authentication-methods policy.

Control Description: Enable Microsoft Authenticator push and passwordless authentication
Dependency: Authentication-methods policy
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID
Leadership Notes: Enable number matching, location and application context where supported and establish secure registration guidance.

Control Description: Enable combined security-information registration
Dependency: Authentication-methods policy
Applies When: All customers using Microsoft MFA or SSPR
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID
Leadership Notes: Use combined registration for MFA and self-service password-reset information.

Control Description: Configure authentication-method registration campaigns
Dependency: Authenticator and registration configurations
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID
Leadership Notes: Deploy by pilot and production groups with deadlines, reminders, exclusions and support procedures.

Control Description: Define standard, phishing-resistant and passwordless authentication strengths
Dependency: Authentication-methods policy and persona mapping
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; required methods and advanced controls may require additional licensing
Leadership Notes: Define appropriate strengths for standard users, privileged users, sensitive applications and high-risk scenarios.

Control Description: Migrate users from legacy MFA and SSPR policy configuration
Dependency: Authentication methods validated and users registered
Applies When: Customers using legacy MFA, SSPR, Duo, Okta or another MFA provider
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 for Conditional Access migration
Leadership Notes: Retire legacy configuration only after policy coverage, registration, emergency access and sign-in testing are validated.

Control Description: Configure SSPR methods, registration and notifications
Dependency: Combined registration and authentication-methods policy
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 for synchronized or writeback scenarios
Leadership Notes: Configure approved methods, notifications, registration requirements, administrator controls and password writeback where applicable.

Control Description: Review active and eligible administrative-role assignments
Dependency: Phase 0 privileged-access inventory
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; P2 or Governance required for PIM eligibility data
Leadership Notes: Validate current assignments, ownership, business need, privilege level and separation between privileged and standard accounts.

Control Description: Replace excessive roles with least-privileged role assignments
Dependency: Administrative-role review
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID
Leadership Notes: Replace Global Administrator and other broad roles with task-appropriate roles wherever operationally feasible.

Control Description: Configure eligible, time-bound privileged-role assignments
Dependency: Role-remediation plan
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance
Leadership Notes: Convert appropriate permanent assignments to eligible assignments with activation duration and expiration controls.

Control Description: Require MFA, justification and approval for sensitive-role activation
Dependency: PIM configuration
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance
Leadership Notes: Apply authentication strength, justification, approval, notification and time-limit requirements based on role sensitivity.

Control Description: Configure and monitor cloud-only emergency-access accounts
Dependency: Administrative-role review and Conditional Access design
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID and monitoring capability
Leadership Notes: Maintain at least two protected cloud-only emergency accounts with secure credentials, exclusions and alerting.

Control Description: Configure recurring reviews for privileged-role assignments
Dependency: PIM configuration and role ownership
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance
Leadership Notes: Require recurring certification of active and eligible assignments with documented remediation of denied or expired access.

Control Description: Define personas, exclusions, dependencies and deployment standards
Dependency: Identity cleanup, MFA design and emergency-access accounts
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; risk-based controls require Entra ID P2
Leadership Notes: Define policy naming, personas, targeting, exclusions, emergency access, testing, rollback and deployment standards.

Control Description: Block legacy authentication protocols
Dependency: Conditional Access design and legacy-authentication analysis
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1
Leadership Notes: Deploy in report-only mode, remediate dependencies and then enforce blocking for legacy authentication.

Control Description: Require phishing-resistant MFA for administrative roles
Dependency: Authentication strengths and emergency-access accounts
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; phishing-resistant methods require compatible authentication devices
Leadership Notes: Protect privileged roles using phishing-resistant authentication while preserving monitored emergency access.

Control Description: Require MFA for applicable users and applications
Dependency: User registration and authentication-method configuration
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1
Leadership Notes: Use staged deployment, report-only validation and controlled enforcement with documented exclusions.

Control Description: Require compliant devices for protected resources
Dependency: Intune enrollment and compliance policies
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1 and Microsoft Intune
Leadership Notes: Apply compliant-device requirements only after supported platforms, BYOD paths and recovery scenarios are validated.

Control Description: Block or remediate high-risk users and sign-ins
Dependency: MFA deployment and Identity Protection validation
Applies When: Customers licensed for risk-based identity protection
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P2
Leadership Notes: Define risk thresholds, secure password-change requirements, MFA remediation, blocking and investigation procedures.

Control Description: Define named locations and trusted network ranges
Dependency: Validated public IP ranges and network-owner approval
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1
Leadership Notes: Document trusted locations carefully and avoid treating location alone as a strong authentication factor.

Control Description: Configure sign-in frequency and persistent-browser restrictions
Dependency: Conditional Access design and application testing
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1; advanced session controls may require Defender for Cloud Apps
Leadership Notes: Apply session controls by persona and application sensitivity rather than using a single tenant-wide value.

Control Description: Deploy new policies in report-only mode before enforcement
Dependency: Conditional Access policies created
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID P1
Leadership Notes: Review report-only results, exclusions, failures and application dependencies before staged enforcement.

Control Description: Configure platform, ownership and device-limit restrictions
Dependency: Endpoint inventory and enrollment architecture
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1
Leadership Notes: Restrict unsupported platforms, personal enrollment where required and excessive device registrations.

Control Description: Configure Windows automatic enrollment
Dependency: Entra join strategy and Intune licensing
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1 and Microsoft Entra ID P1
Complexity Driver: Current join state and enrollment conflicts
Leadership Notes: Configure MDM scope, enrollment permissions and join strategy for cloud-native or hybrid-managed Windows devices.

Control Description: Configure Apple enrollment tokens and enrollment profiles
Dependency: Apple Business Manager access and Intune design
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1 and Apple Business Manager for automated device enrollment
Leadership Notes: Configure enrollment program, Apple MDM push certificate, application tokens and appropriate ownership profiles.

Control Description: Configure operating system, encryption, password and threat compliance
Dependency: Enrollment configuration and supported-platform definition
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1; threat-level integration requires Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Complexity Driver: Platform variation and existing device health
Leadership Notes: Use staged assignments and appropriate grace periods before connecting compliance to Conditional Access.

Control Description: Deploy baseline device settings by platform
Dependency: Enrollment architecture and platform requirements
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1
Complexity Driver: Number of platforms and configuration conflicts
Leadership Notes: Separate security baselines, configuration profiles and platform-specific settings into manageable policy layers.

Control Description: Configure required, available and uninstall application assignments
Dependency: Application inventory and device groups
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1
Leadership Notes: Define assignment rings, dependencies, detection rules, supersedence, uninstall behavior and application ownership.

Control Description: Configure enrollment status page and required application tracking
Dependency: Windows enrollment and required application assignments
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune Plan 1
Leadership Notes: Block device use only for critical applications and policies needed to deliver a secure first sign-in.

Control Description: Onboard supported endpoints to endpoint detection and response
Dependency: Endpoint inventory, licensing and onboarding design
Applies When: Customers deploying Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or Defender for Business
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Business or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1 or Plan 2
Leadership Notes: Use Intune, NinjaOne, Group Policy or scripts and validate sensor health before wide deployment.

Control Description: Configure real-time, cloud-delivered and behavior monitoring
Dependency: Endpoint onboarding and existing antivirus assessment
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender Antivirus; centralized controls require Intune or equivalent management
Leadership Notes: Configure cloud protection, behavior monitoring, scanning, remediation, exclusions and user-interface controls.

Control Description: Enable endpoint detection, response and automated investigation
Dependency: Endpoint onboarding and device-group design
Applies When: Customers licensed for endpoint detection and response
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Business or Defender for Endpoint Plan 2 for full EDR capabilities
Complexity Driver: License level and existing security tooling
Leadership Notes: Configure EDR behavior, automated investigation, remediation levels, device groups and alert routing.

Control Description: Enable tamper protection for managed endpoints
Dependency: Endpoint onboarding and management integration
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Business or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Leadership Notes: Enable tenant and policy-managed tamper protection after validating exclusions and third-party security compatibility.

Control Description: Configure domain, private and public firewall profiles
Dependency: Endpoint management and application dependency inventory
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune or Group Policy
Leadership Notes: Configure profiles, inbound defaults, logging, approved rules and exceptions using staged deployment.

Control Description: Configure BitLocker or platform-equivalent encryption
Dependency: Device inventory, hardware readiness and key-escrow design
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune or equivalent management; applicable Windows edition required
Leadership Notes: Configure encryption method, silent enablement, recovery-key escrow, rotation and support procedures.

Control Description: Deploy local administrator password management
Dependency: Endpoint enrollment and privileged-access design
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune or Active Directory with supported Windows LAPS capabilities
Leadership Notes: Deploy Windows LAPS, restrict local administrators, secure password retrieval and document emergency-access procedures.

Control Description: Configure Attack Surface Reduction rules in audit or warn mode
Dependency: Defender Antivirus policy and application inventory
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender Antivirus; some rules and reporting capabilities vary by license
Leadership Notes: Start in audit or warn mode and collect sufficient telemetry before blocking potentially disruptive behaviors.

Control Description: Move validated ASR rules to block mode
Dependency: ASR audit results and approved exceptions
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender Antivirus and supported endpoint-management platform
Leadership Notes: Enforce in deployment rings and maintain narrowly scoped, documented and time-bound exclusions.

Control Description: Define trusted application and code-execution policies
Dependency: Application inventory and publisher analysis
License Requirement: Windows Defender Application Control or App Control for Business capabilities
Leadership Notes: Use audit mode before enforcement and define trusted publishers, managed installers, exceptions and emergency rollback.

Control Description: Block macros from untrusted and internet-originated files
Dependency: Business macro inventory and exception requirements
License Requirement: Microsoft 365 Apps and supported policy-management platform
Leadership Notes: Block internet-originated macros and allow only documented, trusted and appropriately signed business macros.

Control Description: Configure browser security, extension and download restrictions
Dependency: Browser inventory and business-extension review
License Requirement: Microsoft Intune, Group Policy or equivalent browser-management platform
Leadership Notes: Implement managed browser settings, extension controls, reputation protection and download restrictions.

Control Description: Configure removable-storage and peripheral-device restrictions
Dependency: Business requirement and peripheral inventory
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Intune capabilities vary by policy type
Leadership Notes: Start with auditing and define approved device classes, exceptions, encryption requirements and support procedures.

Control Description: Enable network protection, reputation and malicious-site blocking
Dependency: Defender Antivirus and browser-management baseline
Applies When: Customers using supported Microsoft Defender protections
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Business or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Complexity Driver: Legacy web applications and false positives
Leadership Notes: Enable network protection, SmartScreen and reputation-based protection using staged enforcement.

Control Description: Configure inbound and outbound spam policies
Dependency: Exchange Online assessment and mail-flow discovery
License Requirement: Exchange Online Protection
Complexity Driver: Existing transport rules and third-party gateways
Leadership Notes: Configure inbound, outbound, connection filtering, bulk-mail thresholds and compromised-user protections.

Control Description: Configure common attachment filtering and malware response
Dependency: Exchange Online assessment
License Requirement: Exchange Online Protection
Leadership Notes: Configure malware response, common attachment filtering, notifications and quarantine behavior.

Control Description: Configure impersonation, spoof and mailbox-intelligence protection
Dependency: Protected-user and domain identification
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or Plan 2 for advanced impersonation protection
Leadership Notes: Protect priority users, accepted domains and trusted partners while tuning mailbox intelligence and spoof handling.

Control Description: Configure attachment detonation and delivery actions
Dependency: Mail-flow assessment and pilot recipients
Applies When: Customers licensed for Defender for Office 365
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or Plan 2
Leadership Notes: Configure dynamic delivery or appropriate blocking actions and include SharePoint, OneDrive and Teams protection when licensed.

Control Description: Configure URL scanning, rewriting and click tracking
Dependency: Mail-flow assessment and pilot recipients
Applies When: Customers licensed for Defender for Office 365
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 Plan 1 or Plan 2
Complexity Driver: Business URL workflows and false positives
Leadership Notes: Protect email and supported collaboration workloads while documenting narrowly scoped exclusions.

Control Description: Configure and validate SPF, DKIM and DMARC
Dependency: DNS access and complete sending-source inventory
License Requirement: Exchange Online and public DNS management access
Complexity Driver: Unknown senders and external DNS ownership
Leadership Notes: Inventory all authorized senders before progressing DMARC from monitoring to quarantine or rejection.

Control Description: Configure outbound sending limits and compromised-user response
Dependency: Mail-flow and application-sender inventory
License Requirement: Exchange Online Protection
Leadership Notes: Define outbound thresholds, automatic restrictions, alerting and compromised-account response.

Control Description: Enable integrated user reporting for suspicious messages
Dependency: Security operations routing and mailbox access
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender portal; automated investigation features vary by license
Leadership Notes: Enable the built-in reporting experience and route submissions to Microsoft and the responsible security team.

Control Description: Configure tenant and site external-sharing limits
Dependency: Sharing assessment and business collaboration requirements
License Requirement: SharePoint Online
Leadership Notes: Set tenant maximums and apply more restrictive controls to sensitive sites based on business need.

Control Description: Configure external-sharing and default-link restrictions
Dependency: Sharing assessment and SharePoint sharing design
License Requirement: OneDrive for Business
Complexity Driver: Existing external links and user impact
Leadership Notes: Align OneDrive sharing with organizational policy and use safer default-link types and permissions.

Control Description: Configure guest meeting, messaging and calling capabilities
Dependency: Guest-access requirements and identity controls
Applies When: Customers using Microsoft Teams guest access
License Requirement: Microsoft Teams
Leadership Notes: Configure guest capabilities according to business need and align them with Entra and Microsoft 365 group controls.

Control Description: Restrict Anyone links and configure link expiration
Dependency: Sharing assessment and business approval
License Requirement: SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business
Leadership Notes: Disable Anyone links where unnecessary or apply expiration and limited permissions where business use is approved.

Control Description: Set default sharing links to Specific people or organization-only
Dependency: SharePoint and OneDrive sharing design
License Requirement: SharePoint Online and OneDrive for Business
Leadership Notes: Use Specific people or organization-only defaults to reduce accidental broad sharing.

Control Description: Configure allowed or blocked external-sharing domains
Dependency: Approved partner-domain list and business requirements
Applies When: Customers restricting external collaboration by domain
License Requirement: SharePoint Online and Microsoft Entra external-collaboration controls
Leadership Notes: Use allowlists only where sustainable and establish ownership for recurring domain-list review.

Control Description: Deploy and validate identity threat-detection sensors
Dependency: Domain-controller inventory and network readiness
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Identity or qualifying Microsoft 365 E5 security licensing
Leadership Notes: Deploy sensors to supported domain controllers and validate health, connectivity, sizing and event collection.

Control Description: Identify insecure protocols, configurations and identity exposures
Dependency: Identity sensors healthy and directory access available
Applies When: Customers with hybrid or on-premises identity
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Identity
Complexity Driver: Legacy protocol usage and directory condition
Leadership Notes: Review exposed credentials, lateral-movement paths, insecure protocols, dormant identities and configuration weaknesses.

Control Description: Enable discovery of cloud application usage
Dependency: Network-log source or Defender-supported endpoint telemetry
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps or qualifying suite licensing
Leadership Notes: Use endpoint or firewall telemetry to identify cloud applications, users, traffic volume and unsanctioned services.

Control Description: Review cloud applications by risk score and usage
Dependency: Cloud-app discovery data
Applies When: Customers using Defender for Cloud Apps
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps
Leadership Notes: Prioritize applications by risk, data access, usage, compliance characteristics and business criticality.

Control Description: Review and remediate risky OAuth applications and permissions
Dependency: Enterprise application inventory and consent data
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra ID; advanced application governance requires Defender for Cloud Apps or related licensing
Leadership Notes: Review publisher trust, privilege, consent source, usage and owner before restricting or removing applications.

Control Description: Configure application-session controls for sensitive resources
Dependency: Conditional Access design and sensitive-application identification
License Requirement: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps and Microsoft Entra ID P1
Leadership Notes: Pilot session restrictions for downloads, unmanaged devices and sensitive applications before broad enforcement.

Control Description: Enable and validate unified audit logging
Dependency: Tenant administrative access
License Requirement: Microsoft Purview Audit Standard; advanced retention and events require Audit Premium
Leadership Notes: Validate audit status, searchable events, administrative access and operational ownership.

Control Description: Configure retention or export of sign-in and audit logs
Dependency: Azure subscription or SIEM destination and retention requirements
License Requirement: Microsoft Entra licensing and Azure Log Analytics, Storage or SIEM consumption charges may apply
Leadership Notes: Export sign-in, audit, provisioning and risk logs where native retention does not satisfy operational requirements.

Control Description: Configure alert severity, notification and routing settings
Dependency: Security operations ownership and escalation contacts
License Requirement: Applicable Microsoft Defender licenses; SIEM automation may require Microsoft Sentinel
Leadership Notes: Define severity, notification, ticket routing, escalation, after-hours coverage and false-positive tuning responsibilities.

Control Description: Define DLP scope, rule precedence, exceptions, incident routing and deployment standards

Control Description: Configure policies for sensitive information shared through Exchange Online
Dependency: DLP architecture and validated sensitive-information types
Applies When: Customers protecting sensitive information in email
License Requirement: Microsoft Purview DLP for Exchange Online
Leadership Notes: Begin with simulation or test-with-notification modes before restricting business communications.

Phase: Phase 2 - Data Protection, Governance & AI Readiness
Control Description: Configure policies for sensitive files stored or shared in SharePoint and OneDrive
Dependency: DLP architecture, site inventory and sensitive-information types

Control Description: Configure protection for sensitive information shared in Teams chats and channels
Dependency: DLP architecture and Teams usage assessment
Applies When: Customers protecting sensitive information in Teams

Leadership Notes: Use policy tips and simulation results to reduce disruption to normal collaboration.

Phase: Phase 2 - Data Protection, Governance & AI Readiness
Control Description: Configure monitored activities and restrictions for sensitive data on managed endpoints
Dependency: Endpoint onboarding, device-management baseline and DLP architecture
Applies When: Customers protecting sensitive data on endpoints
